content.title: Who Is Galaxy Girl on ‘The Masked Singer’ Season 14? Clues, Guesses, & Spoilers Revealed!
content.text: The Masked Singer is back! A new episode of season 14 of the hit FOX singing competition series aired on Wednesday night (March 25). The show, which began in South Korea, features celebrities singing songs while wearing costumes and face masks concealing their identities until they’re eliminated. Throughout the season, the contestants provide clues to try and help the judges and fans figure out who is under the mask. This season’s contestants boast a combined total of 94 million records sold, 21 platinum singles, 3 Emmy Award victories, 3 Hall of Famers, 3 World Series wins, and 54 million Instagram followers. For the Semi-Finals, Galaxy Girl hit the stage for a performance “Misery Business” by Paramore. Keep reading to see all of the clues and guesses…Keep scrolling to check out the clues and guesses… FIRST PERFORMANCE CLUES: - She’s a successful child star - She walked away from Hollywood - She’s making a comeback - She holds a heart rock - “Welcome 2 LA” sign shown - Friday the 13th circled on a calendar - She “loves a crowd” PANEL GUESSES: Lindsay Lohan, Jennifer Love Hewitt, & Emma Stone SECOND PERFORMANCE CLUES: - She’s spent her whole life in front of the cameras - Appears to be a New York Times best-selling author - Changed her “whole look” the night before a huge career moment - Says the look was “iconic” - Surfboard shown – possible Teen Choice Awards winner? - Holds up a bowl of oranges - Jingle bells shown, says the holidays are an important part of her career PANEL GUESSES: Dixie D’Amelio, Anne Hathaway, & Hilary Duff THIRD PERFORMANCE CLUES: - Her first concert was Lilith Fair - Spider crawls across a piano - Says “For years, I was lost in the background. I wasn’t the one who sang” - “Dream” written in clouds across a vinyl album cover - Toy gondola floats in a fountain - Alarm clock set to 10:10 - Says “Not everyone earns a halo in life, but in my lifetime, this girl sure did” PANEL GUESSES: Ashlee Simpson, Kate Hudson, & Gwen Stefani FOURTH PERFORMANCE CLUES: - She’s not Gwen Stefani - Vegas showgirls come out on stage - She “works” in Vegas PANEL GUESSES: Taylor Momsen, Avril Lavigne, & Hilary Duff FIFTH PERFORMANCE CLUES: - She’s looked up to one of the world’s biggest stars, who is one of her closet friends - Her BFF faced a lot of public scrutiny - She has connection to Nick Cannon - Her husband is close with Nick - She’s known Nick since the early 2000s - She’s never been on Wild ‘n Out PANEL GUESSES: Ashlee Simpson & Aly Michalka OUR GUESS: Ashlee Simpson Ross Based on the clues, we have a feeling that Ashlee Simpson is under the Galaxy Girl mask. “Friday the 13th” circled on the calendar can be a reference to her song “Just Let Me Cry,” which was featured on the 2003 Freaky Friday soundtrack. In the clue package, she said that she was “lost in the background,” which could refer to Ashlee‘s older sister Jessica Simpson reaching fame before she did. After some taking out of the spotlight to raise her family, Ashlee recently returned to the spotlight with a Las Vegas residency. Also in the package, she said that she was the youngest on stage at the best schools, and Ashlee was the youngest person ever admitted to the School of American Ballet at 11 years old.
